landing.heroTitlePart1: Kuva ku cyifuzo kugeza ku mukono,
landing.heroSubtitle: Buri cyifuzo cy'impapuro cyangwa icyo kugura kigenda uhereye ku mukozi kugeza kuri DAF hanyuma kuri Umunyamabanga Mukuru mu buryo bugenwa neza — bikurikiranwa, bimenyeshwa, kandi byanditswe ku ntambwe imwe n'indi.
landing.step1Desc: Impapuro cyangwa icyifuzo cyo kugura birakorwa bikoherezwa kugira ngo bisuzumwe — nta na kimwe gikomeza mbere yuko birangira.
landing.step2Desc: Umuyobozi w'Imari yemeza cyangwa asubiza n'impamvu. Nta ntambwe na rimwe isimbukwa.
landing.step3Desc: Umunyamabanga Mukuru atanga icyemezo cya nyuma. Umukozi amenyeshwa ako kanya.
landing.footerNote: Federasiyo y'Umupira w'Amaguru mu Rwanda — Amashami ya FERWAFA
